text:
An electromagnet is used to separate magnetic metals from non-magnetic metals.
Why is steel unsuitable as the core of the electromagnet?
A
It is a good conductor of electricity.
B
It forms a permanent magnet.
C
It has a high density.
D
It has a high thermal capacity.

options.label: A
options.text: It is a good conductor of electricity.

options.label: D
options.text: It has a high thermal capacity.
